entityDescription:
Hesse Consulting Group GmbH supports clients in various industries around the globe in achieving better results through the targeted use of structured and creative thought processes.The group consists of the companies CoThink Deutschland GmbH, Direct Impact Group Ltd. and the registered brand 3E. Unsere Kernkompetenzen umfassen: Veränderungsprozesse, Strukturierte Problemlösung, Organisationsentwicklung und Online Moderation + Training

3E supports clients in planning and implementing change processes. Our core competencies cover three topics:- Team development (Empower the Team)- Implementation (Execute the Plan)- Innovation (Evolve the Organisation). Our approach is holistic and ensures that PEOPLE, PROCESSES, CULTURE and SYSTEMS are in synch. We offer training, coaching, facilitation and consulting in the following areas: Project management (classic + agile), change management, Virtual Teams + Online Leadership, Agile Business Models and performance management. 
CoThink offers our clients practical solutions for structured trouble-shooting and prevention. Our facilitation techniques enable you to make the best use of your employees' knowledge and experience. By asking the right questions in combination with our RATIO method, a "learning-by-doing" philosophy and a lot of practical experience, we offer all the services necessary to develop processes, motivation and skills in the areas of trouble-shooting and prevention. We offer training, facilitation and consultancy in the following areas: Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Problem solving.
Direct Impact Group is an international consultancy specialising in maximising sustainability and social impact. We support social organisations and non-profit Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programmes to effectively increase their social impact. Our experienced consultants can draw on their own experience in the non-profit sector. We focus on the core of the tasks and offer clear, simple and proven solutions. We offer advice in these areas: Organisational development, Partnerships + Alliances, Impact acceleration

entityDescription:
The GEM Foundation is a non-profit, public-private partnership that drives a global collaborative effort to develop scientific and high-quality resources for transparent assessment of earthquake risk and to facilitate their application for risk management around the globe.
Assisted by an initiative of the OECD's Global Science Forum, GEM was formed in 2009 as a non-profit foundation in Pavia, Italy, funded through a public-private sponsorship with the vision to createa world that is resilient to earthquakes. GEM’s mission is to become one of the world’s most complete sources of risk resources and a globally accepted standard for seismic risk assessment; and to ensure that its products are applied in earthquake risk management worldwide.
GEM builds capacity to assess and manage risk through open, transparent and collaborative seismic risk assessment at local, national, regional and global scales. Using state-of-the-art tools, GEM is committed to share and advocate open, reliable earthquake risk information to support sound disaster risk-reduction planning at various levels.

entityDescription:
Fundación Instituto Tecnológico de Galicia (ITG, www.itg.es) is a private non-profit research and technology organization set up in 1991, that aims to improve the competitiveness of enterprises, organizations and professionals through research, technological development and professional services. It provides expertise in the design, development and implementation of complex ICT-based technology (software and hardware) for the monitoring and control of processes and infrastructures (mainly energy and water grids, buildings). Its main fields of activity are: Sensing and Telecommunication, Software Engineering, Energy Efficiency, Water Technologies and Construction Technologies.

ITG has a team of more than 60 people, most of them telecommunication, aeronautic, software and industrial engineers. The centre has participated in more than 70 R&D national and international projects and has provided services to 347 different customers during the last three years. ITG has been recognized as a National Technology Center by the Ministry of Economic and Competitiveness of the Spain Government (registration number 115). The entities that constitute its Board of Trustees are: the Regional Government of Galicia; the Universities of A Coruña, Vigo and Santiago de Compostela; the Confederation of Galician Enterprise Associations; the official Galician Associations of Civil Engineers, Industrial Engineers and Architects. ITG chairs the Executive Board of the Spanish Federation of Technological Centres (FEDIT) and is member of the World Association of Industrial and Technological Research Organisations (WAITRO). 

In the aeronautic sector, ITG is member of the following organizations and networks: European Network of U-space Demonstrators, managed by EUROCONTROL; European Organization for Civil Aviation Equipment (EUROCAE), where it is involved in the working-group “Unmanned Aircraft Systems” and contributes to the development of industry standards for unmanned vehicles; advisory Board of the Spanish Agency for the Aeronautic Security (AESA); Galician Association of Unmanned Intelligent Systems (AGASINT).At national level, ITG is member of the network of excellence “iMOV3D: New Technologies for Smart Mobility based on Urban Air Mobility”, funded by the Spanish Centre for Industrial Development (CDTI). This R&D network aims to increase the research capacities on 3 main fields: air vehicle autonomy, intelligent and autonomous control systems for urban air mobility, intelligent collaborative systems for the integration of UAVs in the urban space

Victorydale Limited T/A Leakwatch Systems is an IoT company formed in response to the issue of water damage within residential and commercial properties. 

Damage from water within the property, burst pipes and tanks, taps accidentally left running, leaking appliances; and from outside the property, flooding, rain, and storm damage combined are the cause of 80% of damage to buildings. 

Using sensors and technology we aim to reduce damage to properties and save water. Through early alerting and intervention, problems can be solved before they progress to substantial and costly property damage. Water will also be saved with our smart metering technology.

entityName: Institute for Chemical Processing of Coal
entityDescription:
Institute for Chemical Processing of Coal operates under Act on Research Institutes from the 30th of April 2010. It was established pursuant to The Resolution of Council of Ministers no 192/55 from 1955. The supervising body of the Institute is the Minister of State Assets.
The main recipients and customers of the Institute know-how are companies from power, waste-processing and coke-making industries, small and medium enterprises as well as organizations from government and self-government administration. The Institute participates in many R&D and implementation projects, cooperating with more than 50 national and international scientific and R&D centers.
The prior strategy of the Institute is to gear its research field to the development of low- and zero-emission heat and electrical energy production technologies, including clean coal technologies, CO2 capture and storage (CCS) and utilization (CCU) systems, as well as energy production from renewable resources.
The performance of many analyses on actual and perspective routes of the development of power, heat, waste management and coke-making industries is the basis of current research topics and action lines.
According to the Long-Term Research Program of the Institute the undertaken activities are focused on:
· thermochemical conversion of solid fuels for energy and chemical industry,
· environmentally friendly and economically effective residential and municipal heating systems based on natural and processed solid fuels,
· circular economy – waste to energy or residues to products,
· thermochemical energy storage by means of solid-gas reactions,
· effective and environmentally safe coke making and coal derivatives processing industries,
· advanced materials for novel energy generation technologies and e-mobility (including H2 transport).
All the activities are carried out with the emphasis to environmental protection issues, especially to the reduction of emission of greenhouse gases as well as gaseous and particulate contaminants.
Institute’s references include:
· cokemaking industry – 1770 projects,
· power industry – 1243 projects,
· coal mining – 276 projects,
· carbochemistry – 1135 projects,
· higher education – 209 research projects and scientific grants,
· international projects (including EU) – 125 projects,
· 37 scientific monographs,
· 2508 scientific and technical papers,
· 245 patents, 39 utility models and 34 trade marks,
· 276 organized conferences and scientific seminars.

E.I.T.D. is a limited company, established in 1994. It develops continuous and vocational training and consultancy projects and interventions in favour of private companies, activities of analysis, socio-economic research and technical advice in favour of public administrations.
Operational fields
- Actions aimed at building individual and companies’ competences through continuous training and managerial empowerment (supported also through the so called “interprofessional” category-based funds).
- Joint participation with SMEs, public administrations and research organisations to European programmes’ opportunities with the aim to foster innovation in the organisations.
- Promotion and management of enterprises’ incubators, orientation, training, tutoring and support to entrepreneurship and start-up activities.
- Technical assistance to support national and local institutions in planning, management, monitoring and evaluation of European Funds such as European Regional Development Fund and European Social Fund.
- Analysis and socio-economic research in support to labour policies, integration/reintegration in the labour market and social inclusion of individuals.

Shareholdings and participations
- Trainwork consortium, a private company active on orientation, professional support and integration/reintegration in the labour market.
- Founder member of the Fondazione ITS* for the sustainable mobility and railway transports and of the Fondazione ITS* for the energy efficiency. (*ITS stands for Post-diploma Vocational Educational and Lifelong Learning Institution).
- Associate member of the Industry 4.0 Competence Center of South Italy “MedITech”.
- Associate member of Federation of Neapolitan Employers.
- Supporting member of the Italian Technology Cluster “Smart Communities Tech”.
- Supporting Organization to ADMA project for advanced manufacturing support for SMEs.

Innovation and Technology Transfer
In the recent years, EITD has built an Innovation and Technology Transfer area with skilled persons in project planning, in project design and in the creation of international and European partnerships. The area provides consultancy and support for the participation to research, innovation and technology transfer projects based on European funds.

Roofit Solar Energy is an Estonian company headquartered in Tallinn which operates in the field of Building Integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV) and produces a 2-in-1 innovative product: a metal roof with integrated solar panels. It looks like traditional steel roofs and electrically is as powerful as conventional solar panels.
Roofit.solar focuses on the premium quality and safety measures. To date, there are more than 100 Roofit.solar roofs in Estonia, Germany, Austria, Denmark, Poland, Sweden, Norway, Latvia and Kenya. Apart from the excellent visual aspect and innovativeness of the product, the company promotes green energy to mitigate climate change. Unlike the use of fossil fuels, that emit high levels of carbon dioxide (CO2) and cause severe health and ecological damage, sunlight is free, renewable, infinite, and easily accessible. Therefore, our solar roofs help to reduce harmful effects of carbon footprint and diminish global pollution levels.
The team behind Roofit Solar Energy has experience in research, large-scale international energy projects, product development, export and high-quality service. We have an individual approach towards each client and do our best to provide them with premium quality solar roofs that are efficient and durable for decades to come. And this is just the beginning. We work hard to make solar metal roofs accessible for more and more people around the globe to change the way the world is powered.

entityDescription:
Having provided humanitarian aid over several decades in some of the worst hit places, SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL responds to the basic necessities of the most vulnerable, relieves their suffering, and enables them to retain their dignity and cope with even the most challenging of situations.
Based on the concept of need, this remit translates into delivering water, sanitation and hygiene aid, as well as food security and shelter. How? By supplying aid directly to those who need it, as quickly and efficiently as possible, and in a manner that is both sustainable, participative and effectively coordinated. But not only.
Working closely alongside those in need, SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL also has a duty and a responsibility to record and bear witness, as stipulated by its charter, so that people’s voices are heard and their realities exposed. This way, we can raise awareness among the media, the general public and decision-makers. This can only help us make our support more efficient and the way it is delivered more pertinent.
Taking aid further bearing witness.

entityDescription:
Holoxica’s vision is to “Solve 3D”.Holoxica is a research intensive SME specialising in disruptive holographic 3D solutions from motion video displays to static images. Our tech does not need any head gear where 3D images appear in mid-air, viewable naturally, just like "Star Wars". We have an experienced team delivering on extreme hardware, software and 3D graphics projects. We offer 3D light-field displays capable of showing colour motion video. We can convert any kind of 3D digital data into a hologram. Our technology is positioned beyond current AR/VR and can be a direct replacement for this.The main applications are in professional (B2B) medical, scientific, military, industrial and commercial markets.We have recently pioneered telepresence technology which allows full duplex (two-way) 3D video conferencing across a broadband network.
The Holoxica next-generation display technology is a step improvement over current AR/VR systems that use wearable goggles or glasses. Light field 3D displays do not require any eye-wear, whereby multiple people can view the 3D image and interact with it. Holoxica has built several generations of holographic video displays from simple segmented systems to HUDs, volumetric and light-field displays. We are a value-added reseller for the Looking Glass 3D Light field display, where we build a whole solution computing system, middleware, I/O and graphics software.
Holoxica has extensive, over 55 cumulative years’, experience in managing high tech projects in both consumer and professional electronics. This means taking ideas to proof of concept, prototyping and products. Our team’s areas of expertise include: medical imaging, 3D graphics software, embedded systems, 3D graphics design and display hardware engineering. We have a solid track record and experience of building teams to execute advanced projects. These include grants from the EU Horizon 2020 Programme, Innovate UK and Ministry of Defence DSTL/DASA contracts.

Company description: SPICI srl – Company for Innovation, Cooperation and Internationalization, is a Hub for innovation that, operating as an international accelerator and center for entrepreneurship, designs and supports entrepreneurial development, intergovernmental programs for scientific cooperation, technology transfer and internationalization for startups, university spinoffs and innovative SMEs, and develops digital transformation solutions for enterprises and public administration.
SPICI is an active and interconnected part of the ecosystem of knowhow, digital academies and scientific infrastructures of the Technological Pole of the University of Naples Federico II and within this highly valued context, SPICI provides advanced services for the Italian and European industrial and research system (in particular for startups and SMEs), which include scouting, acceleration, digital innovation, technology transfer, finance for growth.
Leveraging on the extensive and consolidated experience of the founders, SPICI works to encourage the attraction in Italy and Europe of capital, talents and innovative projects, providing specialized consultancy and financing guidance services.
SPICI operates both, directly and through its partners on the entire life cycle of startups, from the business conception phase to development on international markets, supporting teams and companies in the process of:
· information and guidance on business creation and entrepreneurial training;
· animation and scouting of new business ideas and management of pre-incubation and acceleration programs;
· accompanying the creation and development of businesses through tutoring, mentorship, coaching, team building, business development and management of incubation and co-working spaces;
· accompanying access to risk finance (venture capital, business angel);
· support for patenting and technology transfer;
· support for the development of digital transformation solutions;
· access to internationalization programs and initiatives.
 
SPICI, with the aim of supporting companies and public administrations in the process of digital transformation, operates its division FabriTech. It acts as a technological laboratory for the development of digital products — including softwares, mobile and web apps and physical products — and related organizational solutions which impact on the way the organization operates internally and within the market.
SPICI has managed several programs related to business acceleration, among these, there is the “CHINA-ITALY BEST STARTUP SHOWCASE - ENTREPRENEURSHIP COMPETITION” the bilateral platform aimed at promoting the internationalization of Italian and Chinese innovative enterprises (startups, spinoffs, SMEs) that offers the opportunity to get close, approach, do business and land in the two Countries and to meet investors, incubators, science parks and partners through an intense and qualified networking activity.

entityDescription:
Siemens Healthineers is a global powerhouse in healthcare, combining the agility, independent-thinking, and responsiveness of a strategy consulting firm with the research and scaling capabilities of a leader in medical technology. Our mission is to enable healthcare providers to increase value by empowering them on their journey towards expanding precision medicine, transforming care delivery, and improving patient experience, all enabled by digitalizing healthcare. An estimated five million patients worldwide everyday benefit from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine as well as digital health and enterprise services, such as consulting. With over 54,000 employees in more than 70 countries, over 120 years of experience and 18.500 patents globally, we will continue to innovate and shape the future of healthcare. 

At the heart of this leader in medical technology sits Value Partners for Healthcare Consulting. We are an independent and vendor agnostic strategy consulting unit at Siemens Healthineers with offices in Berlin, Erlangen, and Singapore. Our interdisciplinary team of doctors, nurses, health scientists and economists has successfully completed more than 500 projects worldwide since our inception 22 years ago. Embedding a strategy consulting unit into the global network of Siemens Healthineers’ technology leadership creates impactful synergies that our clients are profiting from. This combination generates value from how Siemens Healthineers shapes the technology landscape with its comprehensive and innovative portfolio but also beyond the product by a more profound understanding of our customers’ challenges and needs through the consulting business. As a result, we are shapingthe future of healthcare by our own groundbreaking technology innovations and help our customers unlocking their full potential by our wide-ranging expertise in strategic and transformational consulting services. With the help of our deep clinical and medical knowledge, digital platforms, and global SIEMENS network, we strive to build long-term relationships with our customers helping them to further improve healthcare delivery and provide better care at lower cost.
